narrative.title: The Firewall Bracket Audit
narrative.scenario: A network appliance parses configuration lines made only of round, square, and curly brackets. A line is accepted only if every opening symbol is sealed by its exact matching partner, seals occur in the correct nesting order, and no closer appears without a pending opener. Write the audit routine that accepts or rejects each line.
narrative.inputFormat: A string s containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']'.
narrative.outputFormat: Return true if the bracket sequence is valid, false otherwise.
constraints: s consists of bracket characters only

testCases.explanation: Each bracket pair is well-formed and the three pairs sit side by side.
A round opener cannot be sealed by a square closer.

Level 2: Push openers; on a closer, demand that the stack top be its exact partner.
Level 3: Two rejection paths to catch early: a closer arriving on an empty stack, and leftovers on the stack at the end.
